notes: An ArcGIS Hub dataset page draws everything in the browser: the captured HTML has no links, no description and a <title> of 'ArcGIS Hub'. isDataset is FALSE on purpose — from this HTML alone nobody could say it describes a dataset, and the honest answer is to keep nothing rather than invent something. In production `inspectHubDataset` reads the portal's catalogue record instead and never asks the model. What this fixture protects is that an empty page produces an empty answer.
